Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:10:1.hebrew: בדנפחי - דפטיש, היינו קורנס, אסור, דהוי קלא רבה, ואולודי קלא אסור:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:10:1.english: Of smiths - Where a hammer, that is, a sledgehammer, is prohibited, because it [makes] a loud noise, and generating noise is prohibited.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:10:2.hebrew: מתניתין דמתקנין אלו בחוש"מ בדנגרי - במנעול של עץ שרי, דלא הוי קלא רבה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:10:2.english: Our Mishnah, [which states] that these may be repaired on Chol HaMoed, [refers to the work] of carpenters - With a wooden lock it is permitted, because there is not a loud noise.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:11:1.hebrew: מגלי - מסר הגדול, שרי, דלא מוליד קלא כלום:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:11:1.english: Maggalei - A large saw; [it] is permitted, for it produces no noise at all.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:11:2.hebrew: בחציני - ברר"א אסיר, דהוי אולודי קלא טפי:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:11:2.english: With chisels - [With a chisel/axe (text: ברר"א),] it is prohibited, as it produces more noise.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:11:3.english: After he decreed - Yochanan the High Priest.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:12:1.hebrew: הא ר' יהודה הא ר' יוסי - בפירקא דלקמן (מועד קטן דף יב.), דרבי יוסי לא בעי לשנויי לדבר האבד; ומתני' דשרי הכא כל הני בלא שינוי, ר' יוסי היא:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:12:1.english: That [is] Rabbi Yehuda, this [is] Rabbi Yosei - In the next chapter (Moed Katan 12a), [it is stated] that Rabbi Yosei does not require making a change for a matter that will be lost; and our Mishnah, which permits all these [labors] here without a change, is [in accordance with] Rabbi Yosei.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:1:1.hebrew: יריד של עכו"ם - יומא דשוקא:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:1:1.english: A fair of idolaters - A market day.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:1:2.hebrew: ומעלה בערכאות - לקיימן בחתימתן, דכיון דהשתא הוא דמשכח להו וליומא אחרינא לא, שרי:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:1:2.english: And brings [them] up in [their] courts - To validate them with their signature[s]; for since it is now that he finds them, and on another day [he does] not, it is permitted.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:2:1.hebrew: אוהרי - שצדין בו דגים, שקורין רוש"א:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:2:1.english: Oharei - [A trap] with which they catch fish, which is called rusche [in Old French].

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:2:2.english: Izlei - Nets with which one traps birds.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:3:1.english: To construct an oven - To make the oven anew.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:3:3.hebrew: בימות החמה - כלומר, כשיש ימות החמה, כגון בפסח דחבול עלמא שאין יורדין בו גשמים, מותר לעשות בו תנור, לפי שלאלתר יבש, ויכולין לאפות בו פת ברגל לצורך הרגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:3:3.english: In the summer - That is to say, when it is the summer season, such as on Passover, when the world is warm [and] rain does not fall during it, it is permitted to make an oven during it, because it dries immediately and they can bake bread in it on the Festival for the need of the Festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:3:4.hebrew: כאן בימות הגשמים - כלומר, כשיורדין הגשמים ברגל, כגון בסוכות, אין עושין תנור, לפי שאינו יבש לאלתר עד לאחר הרגל, ועבד טירחא שלא לצורך הרגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:3:4.english: Here, in the rainy season - That is to say, when rain falls on the Festival, such as on Sukkot, one may not make an oven, because it does not dry immediately, [not] until after the Festival, and [thus] he performs toil that is not for the need of the Festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:1.hebrew: מעקה למרפסת - כותל קטנה העושין על האיצטבות שלפני העליות גדולות, כעין שיש על שפת נהר רייניס:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:1.english: A railing for a balcony - A small wall that they make on the platforms in front of the large upper stories, like those that are on the bank of the Rhine River.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:2.english: One may plaster the cracks - [That are] in an oven.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:3.english: And roll over them with a roller - [Meaning] that they roll a large, round [piece of] wood over the floor of the oven in order to seal the cracks.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:4.hebrew: ביד וברגל - שלוקח בידו עץ ובועטין ביד על התנור לסתום הסדקים, או בועט ברגלו על קרקעות התנור:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:4.english: With a hand or a foot - That one takes a piece of wood in his hand and presses with [his] hand against the oven to seal the cracks, or presses with his foot on the floor of the oven.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:5.hebrew: מחלצים - עץ כעין רגל שדוחקו במעזיבה לסתום הסדקין, ויש בו מעשה אומן יותר ממעגילה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:4:5.english: A presser - A piece of wood shaped like a foot that one presses into the plaster to seal the cracks, and it involves more craftsmanship than a roller.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:1.hebrew: ציר - רגל הדלת, כמו הדלת תסוב על צירה (משלי כ״ו:י״ד):
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:1.english: Hinge - The foot of the door, like [the verse]: "The door turns upon its hinge" (Proverbs 26:14).

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:2.hebrew: צינור - הוא החור שבאסקופא התחתונה, כמו צינורא דדשא:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:2.english: Cylinder [tzinor] - It is the hole in the lower threshold, like tzinora dedasha [the socket of the door].

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:3.hebrew: הקורה - מה שעל הפתח שתחזור בו הדלת, וקורין אוברטו"ר:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:3.english: The beam - That which is above the doorway in which the door turns, and they call [it] overtur [Old French].

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:5:5.english: Provided that he does not intend to do his labor on the Festival - When he has [the opportunity] to repair all these during the other days of the year, and he leaves it until the Festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:6:1.hebrew: וכבשין - של ציר, כלומר דגים ושאר דברים שכובשים במלח, שיכול לאוכלן במועד, שלא יהא צריך להמתין באכילתן עד לאחר המועד, שיהו נכבשין מהר וראויין לאכול מיד:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:6:1.english: And preserved foods - [That are] of brine; that is to say, fish and other things that one preserves in salt, which he can eat on the Festival, so that he will not need to wait to eat them until after the Festival, for they become preserved quickly and are fit to eat immediately.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:7:1.english: Hutza - Fronds of a palm tree.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:7:2.english: Dofna - They make side-posts of a fence [from it].

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:7:3.english: And he does not plaster with clay - This is the work of a layman.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:8:1.english: A roller - [It is] more in the manner of craftsmanship [than with a hand or a foot].

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:8:2.hebrew: ביד וברגל - דלאו מעשה אומן הוא, לא כל שכן:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:8:2.english: With a hand or a foot - Since it is not the work of a craftsman, [is it] not all the more so [permitted]?

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:8:3.hebrew: כעין מעגילה - ולא מעגילה ממש, אלא כעין מעגילה ביד וברגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:8:3.english: Like a roller - And not an actual roller, rather like a roller, with the hand and with the foot.

Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:9:1.hebrew: עד ימיו - של יוחנן כ"ג, היה פטיש מכה בירושלים בחולו של מועד, והוא גזר עליו ובטלו. אלמא אסור, ומתני' קתני ומתקנין מנעול ומפתח:
Rashi on Moed Katan 11a:9:1.english: Until his days - [the days] of Yochanan the High Priest, a hammer would strike in Jerusalem during the intermediate days of the Festival, and he decreed against it and abolished it. Thus, [it is] forbidden, yet our Mishnah teaches, "and one may fix a lock and a key."
